# The Hexact gateway — recovered return-type shapes

**Generated by `tools/type_map.py`. Do not hand-edit.**

Source: `https://api.hexowatch.com/v2/ql`. Recovered from validator error messages with no credential and no resolver entered, the same way [`GATEWAY.md`](GATEWAY.md) was — one level deeper.

- **357 types** walked, **349 with recovered fields**, 8 undiscovered
- **1155 subfields**, 4151 requests, **0 resolvers entered** (must be 0)

## Why this file exists

`GATEWAY.md` stops at the return type's *name*. GraphQL will not accept a document that selects an object without naming its subfields, so a field whose type is opaque is a field you cannot call. Everything here was recovered from `Cannot query field "idZz" on type "WatchPropertyType". Did you mean "id"?` — the same suggester, asked about output types.

**Inert by construction.** The path field in every probe carries a deliberately invalid argument, which fails validation for the whole document, so no resolver on any level runs. The walker asserts this per response and aborts on the first non-null `data` rather than tallying breaches afterwards.

## Coverage limit — read before concluding a field does not exist

Reach is bounded by edit distance from the probe, so this is a **lower bound**. Measured: the type `webhook` reported zero fields until `eventZz` was added to the seeds — it has `events`, and none of `id`/`url`/`type`/`subscriptionId`, so every obvious seed missed it. A type listed with no fields was **not reached**; it is not empty.

> `AdminSettingsType`, `ChatGptIntegrationDataType`, `GetPropertyUptimeLogMutationResult`, `HexofyUserSettingsType`, `HexoscopeUserSettingsType`, `KeywordType`, `SpeedSettings`, `UserWatchConfig`

## How to read an entry

`leaf` is a scalar or enum — selectable directly. Anything else is the object type that field returns, and needs its own selection set; look it up in this file. The **Selection** line under each table is a paste-ready set of that type's leaves only.
